pages.quiz:
MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 2.5
   B. 0.205
   C. 0.025
   D. 0.25

2. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 10

3. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 400

4. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 90
   C. 36
   D. 18

5. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 1
   C. 12
   D. 13

6. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 26
   C. 5
   D. 25

7. Solve for x: x + 8 = 20. (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 12
   C. 20
   D. 8

8. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15
   C. 17
   D. 3

9. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 18 cm³
   C. 9 cm³
   D. 12 cm³

10. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 169
   C. 13
   D. 170

11. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 32
   C. 33
   D. 4

12. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 49
   C. 14
   D. 7

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

2. Substitute values: Area = 9 × 9
3. Area = 81
Final Answer: 81 m²
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

2. Substitute values: Product = 4 × 3
3. Product = 12
Final Answer: 12
